claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu describes lower astral entities as egregors generated by souls' attention and fear, which then seek more of that energy.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says collective attention can strengthen them.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says the lower astral and material realms have no tangible boundary; souls experience them through differing perception and frequency.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She attributes limited perception of other realms to the biological body.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says sustained high vibration keeps people beyond lower astral entities' reach.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says entities may target unresolved vulnerabilities to lower a person's vibration.
